title: Conuclei on varieties of hoops
summary: A conucleus $δ$ on a partially ordered monoid $\mathbf{A}$ is an interior operator that satisfies $δ(a) \cdot δ(b) \leq δ(a \cdot b)$ and $δ(a) \cdot δ(1) = δ(a)$ for all $a,b \in A$. A conucleus is multiplicative if the equality $δ(a \cdot b) = δ(a) \cdot δ(b)$ holds for all $a,b \in A$. In this article we focus on the study of conuclei on hoops, structures which generalize well-known classes of algebras, such as the class of MV-algebras and BL-algebras.
